# apple_game_center_app_versions (Data Source)

Lists the Game Center app versions of an app: the App Store versions Game Center is set up for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_app_versions" "example" {
  game_center_detail_id = data.apple_game_center_detail.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `app_versions` (Attributes List) The Game Center app versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--app_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_versions`

Read-Only:

- `app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Game Center is on for the version.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center app version.
